verdict.rationale: The API reference lists A/R aging among the financial reports it can generate on demand, and the product markets an Invoicing module ("Get paid faster"). That gives core receivables tracking some support, but only through thin, glancing mentions. Missing for 10: evidence of per-customer receivable balances, detail on the A/R aging report itself (buckets, drill-down, in-app UI rather than API-only), in-depth invoicing/AR docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
